name: bandit.phase4_quiet_former_radar_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live proof that a populated bandit camp six OMT from the real player does not create a radar/player lead or outing. Three hours of real cadence may add bounded structural terrain priors, but every saved lead must remain structural_routine and the camp must remain idle.

steps.label: post_load_quiet_former_radar_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the populated quiet-camp fixture loads with the player six OMT east; this screen is startup footing and final proof comes from the saved-state audit
steps.failure_rule: If the game does not load, no quiet no-radar proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_saved_quiet_zero_evidence
steps.abort_reason: the fixture did not begin with one populated idle camp and zero evidence
steps.expected_immediate_state: the selected camp has five ready members, only the matching five-member transitional scalar headcount, no inherited spawn-tile heads, no active outing, and zero leads before live cadence
steps.failure_rule: A pre-existing lead, outing, or inherited spawn-tile headcount would make later origin claims ambiguous.

steps.label: wait_3_hours_inside_former_radar_radius
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the three-hour duration
steps.expected_visible_fact: three real in-game hours exercise repeated old-radar cadence windows; elapsed credit depends on same-run maintenance/evidence artifacts
steps.failure_rule: If the wait does not reach repeated cadence or its evidence artifacts are absent, the live control is inconclusive.

steps.label: open_save_quit_after_quiet_cadence
steps.expected_visible_fact: save/quit is requested after the quiet cadence window
steps.failure_rule: Final saved-state proof must fail if save/quit input did not produce persisted cadence state.

steps.label: confirm_save_quit_after_quiet_cadence
steps.expected_visible_fact: save/quit completes after the quiet cadence window
steps.failure_rule: Final saved-state proof must fail if cadence state was not written.

steps.label: audit_saved_quiet_only_structural_origins
steps.abort_reason: saved state gained a non-structural lead, exceeded the bounded lead window, or created an outing near the player
steps.expected_immediate_state: the camp remains fully home and idle; all bounded same-run leads are legitimate structural terrain priors
steps.failure_rule: Any radar/signal/observer/returned-report origin, active target, outside member, or unbounded lead growth makes the no-radar proof red.

steps.label: audit_quiet_structural_only_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run artifact did not show idle structural maintenance, bounded structural provenance, and no physical field signal
steps.failure_rule: The saved result is insufficient without same-run cadence and provenance output.

steps.label: audit_no_radar_or_player_writer_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run artifact exposed a player-coordinate writer, non-structural origin, dispatch, or handoff
steps.failure_rule: Any forbidden provenance or outing transition makes the no-radar control red.

evidence_contract.claim: a real five-member bandit camp six OMT from the player stays idle across three live hours without player-coordinate or radar discovery; legitimate bounded structural terrain priors remain allowed and are proven as the only saved lead origin
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for no-radar behavior
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 quiet live credit unless exact fixture zero-evidence footing, elapsed live cadence, saved all-structural provenance, no active outing, same-run evidence diagnostics, and forbidden-writer absence are all green.
